verdict.rationale: Trilegal's own pages describe inbound and outbound M&A for domestic and international investors, and list global PE clients (Blackstone, KKR, Carlyle, Prosus), including a Meesho reverse-merger matter. Venture-specific cross-border work is thin, and the footprint is India-only. Missing for 10: explicit flip/redomiciliation practice documentation, multi-jurisdiction venture financing deal examples, venture-specific (not PE/M&A) cross-border matters, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings

citations.quote: We advise on inbound and outbound mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, entry strategy and strategic alliances
